title: add downgrade guard, backup/restore improvements, and schema migration rollback support for private-installer
author: Monica Patel
body: Motivation: Customers deploying redwood-private in VPC/on-prem environments need safe upgrade and downgrade guarantees. This PR implements a downgrade guard, improves backup/restore integration for helm/terraform flows, and adds rollback-friendly schema migration support. The changeset aims to make upgrades non-destructive and enable automated rollback in case of partial failures. Summary of changes: 1) Downgrade guard: Added a pre-upgrade validation step that pins component versions and prevents applying a release that would drop DB schema compatibility. The guard runs in the installer CLI and the helm pre-upgrade hook. 2) Backup/restore improvements: Centralized backup orchestration across Postgres and object storage with predictable snapshot naming and retention policy. Added verification steps that validate snapshot integrity before schema migration. 3) Schema migrations: Introduced migration metadata with safe down scripts where possible and a rollback plan generator that composes reverse DDL steps for supported migrations. 4) Terraform & Helm integration: Terraform module now exposes backup hooks and upgrade safe flags, Helm charts include new pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks to coordinate backups and restore. 5) Docs and examples: Added operator docs describing upgrade/downgrade flows, and example automation for canary upgrades. Implementation notes: The downgrade guard checks current installed version against the requested release and inspects migration metadata in the chart's /migrations directory. If any migration is flagged irreversible or lacks a down script, the guard will require an explicit "force-downgrade" flag and emits a warning that rollback may require manual intervention. Backup orchestration supports S3-compatible endpoints and local NFS backups for air-gapped installs. Migration metadata schema versioned as v1; tooling tolerates older metadata but will require migration to v1 for full automation. Testing: Unit tests added for migration metadata parsing, helm hook scripts tested end-to-end in KIND and an internal VPC dev cluster, and a manual upgrade/downgrade runbook was executed against a staging cluster with 5GB dataset. CI: initial CI failed due to flake in terraform fmt which was fixed in a follow-up commit. Release notes included below. Rollout: merged to main and will be cut into release v2026.02.25-priv with post-release verification run scheduled on 2026-03-01.
commits: initial: add migration metadata parsing and downgrade guard CLI
backup: centralize backup/restore orchestration and snapshot verification
helm: add pre-upgrade and post-rollback hooks for backups
terraform: expose backup hooks and upgrade_safe flag
docs: add upgrade/downgrade runbook and examples
tests: add unit tests for migration metadata and e2e upgrade scenario fixes
review_comments: Amit Rao: Can we make the downgrade guard non-blocking behind a flag for automated infra pipelines? I don't want it to fail overnight runs without an override.
Monica Patel: Added --force-downgrade and --ignore-guard flags; default is blocking. The runbook documents when to use force.
Eleni Karras: Please add explicit telemetry/metrics for guarded failures so SRE can alert on blocked upgrades.
Monica Patel: Added metrics: upgrade_guard.blocks_total and upgrade_guard.block_reasons. Instrumented in the CLI and helm hooks.
Samir Desai: Terraform formatting nit and a minor permission change for the backup role; also would like an example for air-gapped S3-compatible storage.
Monica Patel: Addressed terraform fmt and added docs/example for MinIO air-gapped endpoint.
Eleni Karras: Verified e2e tests in staging, approving pending green CI.
CI: initial run failed on terraform fmt; follow-up commit fixes formatting and retries, subsequent CI passed.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for migration metadata parsing and downgrade guard logic. Helm chart hooks validated in KIND and internal VPC cluster. Manual e2e upgrade/downgrade performed on staging cluster with 5GB dataset; backup, schema migration, and rollback verified. Terraform plan runs validated in CI and formatting issues fixed before merge.
release_notes: Adds a downgrade guard to prevent accidental incompatible rollbacks, enhances backup/restore orchestration (S3/NFS/MinIO support), and introduces rollback-aware schema migrations with reversible down scripts where available. Operators should read the new upgrade/downgrade runbook before upgrading. Non-breaking by default but requires chart migration to access full automation.
merge_notes: Squash-merged after approvals from reviewers. Tag v2026.02.25-priv will include these changes. Post-merge: scheduled automated verification on staging and notification to customers with active private-installer reservations.
notes_for_ops: Before upgrading production private installs: 1) Run installer --dry-run to surface any irreversible migrations. 2) Ensure backups exist and verify snapshot integrity via scripts/backup/verify_snapshot.sh. 3) If planning a downgrade, export migration metadata and prepare manual rollback steps for irreversible migrations. 4) Contact SRE if upgrade_guard.blocks_total metric increases unexpectedly.
